primitives.name: Blob gateway API
primitives.desc: Content-addressed blob gateway: manifest and chunk upload, receipt locators served to attestors, Merkle helpers and batch metadata for multi-leaf anchors.

primitives.name: Gateway auth and tokens
primitives.desc: Three-tier upload auth — tenant-scoped bearer tokens, legacy api-keys, sr25519 upload signatures with balance gating — plus the admin token lifecycle.

primitives.name: Gateway faucet
primitives.desc: Public one-drip-per-address MATRA faucet with IP cooldown, genesis-namespaced ledger and optional operator identity capture.

primitives.name: Receipt indexer
primitives.desc: Polls the chain for submitted receipts and writes the authoritative receipt-id to content-hash index the locator route serves.

primitives.name: Sponsored receipts
primitives.desc: Upload-completion callback that lets a bearer-authenticated client obtain an on-chain receipt without holding a Materios key; a sponsor signs on their behalf.

primitives.name: Billing and metering
primitives.desc: Pay-per-use admission control and usage accounting with measurement and live phases, plus compute-metering ingestion.

primitives.name: Witness observations
primitives.desc: Witness Network observation intake and registry: attested AI-model behaviour observations, witness targets and topology.

primitives.name: Attestation evidence
primitives.desc: TEE attestation-evidence intake, attestor registry and lift to the tee-attestation pallet.

primitives.name: Explorer and status
primitives.desc: Chain, validator and operator explorer plus status endpoints: producing-liveness, SPO journey and rewards.

primitives.name: Operator registry and heartbeats
primitives.desc: Operator registration, heartbeat intake and fleet-operator registry consumed by probation and liveness tooling.

primitives.name: Event firehose
primitives.desc: Streaming feed of gateway events for downstream consumers.

primitives.name: Cardano L1 anchor verifier
primitives.desc: Checks a checkpoint batch's Cardano anchor against the chain through Koios instead of trusting the gateway record: a well-formed batch whose leaves recompute to its root and include the receipt leaf, tx in a block, label-8746 materios-anchor-v2 record matching the batch root, leaf count, block range and Materios genesis and hashing to its anchor id, and every input spent from an allowlisted anchor wallet. Total over hostile batch records and Koios answers; a tx still missing an hour after it was sent fails; settled at 15 confirmations. Chain facts of a verified tx at least k = 2160 blocks deep are persisted; other answers are re-read after a minute.

primitives.name: Trace lineage
primitives.desc: Public provenance graph for a trace (HTML and JSON): manifest, on-chain receipt, attestor quorum, certificate, checkpoint batch reached through the receipt's leaf, and the Cardano L1 anchor with its verification state.

primitives.name: Bounded SS58 codec
primitives.desc: The only place caller-supplied SS58 strings are decoded: decodeAccountId/checkAccountAddress reject anything over 66 characters before base58 runs, closing the unauthenticated quadratic-decode DoS. A test fails if any other module reaches a base58 sink.
